title: PipelineTabularDataSynth
summary: An experimental research pipeline and evaluation artifact for a paper on privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data generation, combining CTGAN/TVAE variants with mode-patching post-processing and HEOM-kNN privacy filtering across Credit, Adult, and Cardio datasets. It subclasses and modifies SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (and the underlying ctgan package) to build custom synthesizer variants, and uses sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata and sdmetrics privacy metrics for evaluation.
